links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT-3.5 answers to patient questions about total knee arthroplasty
links.effect: FKGL readability scores were high, meaning responses require a high level of education; the abstract reports no numeric FKGL values and says this level can be reduced.
links.quote: The readability scores for FKGL were high.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 responses to frequently asked patient questions regarding total knee arthroplasty via clinician/patient surveys and readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
